speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are presenting with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mouth, and small red spots on your skin. To understand what is causing these symptoms, have you been bruising easily or experiencing excessive bleeding after cuts or dental work?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Thrombocytopenia (likely Immune Thrombocytopenia).

I have noted your history of easy bruising, petechiae on the extremities, and bleeding from the gums and nose. To confirm the suspected low platelet count, do you know if a CBC with differential or a complete blood count has been performed recently?
